name: How a write is made
intro: Every command that changes the record takes its content the same way, previews the same way, and leaves the files in the same shape — the behaviours below are shared by all of them.

name: Refusals at the moment of writing
intro: The standard is held at the point the entry is written, while whoever is writing it still has the context to fix it — rather than as a list of complaints collected up much later.

name: How a change shows up
intro: The documents always describe the product as it stands now; these are the ways the work of the current cycle is marked up inside that, and how each mark takes care of itself once the release is presented.

name: Print fidelity
intro: What makes the finished file behave like a real document rather than a screenshot of one: type that is actually embedded, text that copies out as the words it is, and colour that prints as specified.
